setup: Two fractions with the same numerator are added.

steps.say: Both fractions take the same numerator [[a]], over the denominators [[b]] and [[d]].
A common denominator is a multiple of both denominators, so each fraction is rewritten with its numerator scaled by the same factor as its denominator.
Once the denominators match, the scaled numerators are added.

answer: So the value asked for is [[answer]].
